OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. Submitted numbers may include spaces,
            dashes and brackets and may carry an explicit '+' country code; they are stored
            and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits). A number without a
            '+' is assumed to be Australian ('+61'), dropping a single leading '0'.
          type: string
          minLength: 2
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9 ()\-]{2,20}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on creation it
            defaults to the server's current date. Formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer

<groupId>org.openapitools</groupId>
                <artifactId>openapi-generator-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <!-- RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <version>${maven.openapi-generator-plugin.version}</version>
                <!-- /RELEASE_VERSION -->
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <inputSpec>${project.basedir}/src/main/resources/openapi.yml</inputSpec>
                            <generatorName>spring</generatorName>
                            <library>spring-boot</library>

                            <!-- Only enabling model andopenapi-generator-maven-plugin API generation -->
                            <modelNameSuffix>Dto</modelNameSuffix>
                            <apiPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.api</apiPackage>
                            <generateModels>true</generateModels>
                            <modelPackage>org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto</modelPackage>
                            <generateApis>true</generateApis>
                            <importMappings>
                                <importMapping>Nullable=org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable</importMapping>
                            </importMappings>
                            <configOptions>
                                <!-- RestController implementation is provided by Petclinic developers -->
                                <interfaceOnly>true</interfaceOnly>
                                <!-- Generate API interfaces from OpenAPI tags -->
                                <useTags>true</useTags>
                                <!-- Activating Java 8 features -->
                                <performBeanValidation>true</performBeanValidation>
                                <useSpringBoot3>true</useSpringBoot3>
                                <useJakartaEe>true</useJakartaEe>
                                <openApiNullable>false</openApiNullable>
                                <!-- override the default library to jersey2 -->
                                <serializationLibrary>jackson</serializationLibrary>
                                <!-- switch documentation provider to springdoc -->
                                <documentationProvider>springdoc</documentationProvider>
                            </configOptions>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
                <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>add-source</id>
                        <phase>generate-sources</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>add-source</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <sources>
                                <source>target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java</source>
                            </sources>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>default-compile</id>
                        <configuration>
                            <annotationProcessorPaths>
                                <path>
                                    <groupId>org.mapstruct</groupId>
                                    <artifactId>mapstruct-processor</artifactId>
                                    <version>${mapstruct.version}</version>
                                </path>
                            </annotationProcessorPaths>
                            <compilerArgs>
                                <compilerArg>
                                    -Amapstruct.suppressGeneratorTimestamp=true
                                </compilerArg>
                                <compilerArg>
                                    -Amapstruct.suppressGeneratorVersionInfoComment=true
                                </compilerArg>
                                <compilerArg>
                                    -Amapstruct.defaultComponentModel=spring
                                </compilerArg>
                            </compilerArgs>
                        </configuration>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
            </plugin>

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rule for `POST /api/owners` following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions, mirroring the existing `CheckOwnerTelephoneUnique` pattern.

**What the rule does:** rejects creating an owner when another owner already has the same `lastName` *and* `address` (compared case-insensitively, with surrounding/repeated whitespace collapsed) with **409 Conflict** — unless the request body sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

**Changes:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added an optional `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema so it binds onto the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` request body.

2. **`OwnerHousehold.java`** — a small single-source-of-truth helper that normalizes a value (trim, collapse inner whitespace, lower-case via `Locale.ROOT`) for comparison.

3. **`CheckOwnerHouseholdUnique.java`** — the new pipeline step: reads the published `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`, short-circuits when `sharesHousehold` is true, otherwise compares normalized `lastName`+`address` against every stored owner and throws a checked `OwnerHouseholdDuplicateException` on a match.

4. **`OwnerHouseholdDuplicateException.java`** + **`OwnerHouseholdDuplicateExceptionHandler.java`** — checked escalation and its 409 handler.

5. **Escalation YAML** `.../OwnerHouseholdDuplicateException.yml` — wires the exception to the handler.

6. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted a `checkHousehold` step (with `govern: [ transaction ]`) between `checkTelephone` and `build`.

**Tests:** `AcceptanceTest` (all 3 — reject-on-duplicate, allow-different-address, allow-with-sharesHousehold) and the full suite pass — `BUILD SUCCESS`.
